prerequisites: Basic knowledge of digital technology (Boolean algebra, KV diagram)
Basic knowledge of communication technology (ISO/OSI layer model)

learning_outcomes.text: Students will expand their knowledge of the fundamental concepts and techniques of control technology.
They will learn about the components of automation systems as well as the structure and operation of PLC systems.
Through programming and model-based programming of PLCs, they will acquire practical skills for structuring and implementing control projects.
They will become familiar with design methods to develop efficient solutions.
The introduction to handling technology, industrial process control technology, industrial communication systems, and safety technology will expand their specialized knowledge and application areas.
Consideration of sustainability and future technologies will sensitize them to current challenges and developments in the industry.
Through practical laboratory exercises, they will deepen their understanding and gain practical experience for their professional career.
Students will have a comprehensive understanding of the fundamentals and concepts of control technology.
They will be able to identify and understand the components of an automation system, as well as analyze the structure of control projects.
They will master basic knowledge for programming and model-based programming of PLCs and be familiar with various design methods.
Their knowledge will also include basic aspects of handling technology, industrial process control technology, industrial communication systems, safety technology, and sustainability.
Through laboratory exercises, they will have gained practical experience and can apply their knowledge in real applications.
Students will be able to apply and transfer their acquired knowledge and skills in various areas.
They will understand the basic concepts of control technology as well as the components and operation of automation systems and PLC systems.
Through their knowledge in programming and model-based programming of PLCs, they will be able to structure and efficiently design control projects.

syllabus_topics: Structure and operation of PLC systems
Programming and model-based programming of PLCs
Several consecutive laboratory exercises complement and deepen the lecture material
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance can be an oral exam or a written exam, chosen by the lecturer. The ungraded examination performance consists of experimental work, totaling approximately 5 experiments, each lasting 90 minutes. For the duration of the oral exam and written exam, refer to the general part of the examination regulations and the respective valid study regulations.
